pr_title: fix(es/codegen): Skip `lo` of a program if body is not empty
pr_comments:
@jridgewell Do you think this is correct?
The actual problem of #6767 is that the `span.lo` of `Module` does not match `span.lo` of the first item.

I tried it, but it resulted in extremely huge source maps.
So I reverted it.

The problem was that so many nodes have `DUMMY_SP`

We can optimize source maps output, but we still need all locations:
- https://github.com/jridgewell/gen-mapping/blob/9ff6f25fa9bd12eeb9d265a17dd7631133669fdc/src/gen-mapping.ts#L420-L458
- https://github.com/jridgewell/gen-mapping/blob/9ff6f25fa9bd12eeb9d265a17dd7631133669fdc/src/gen-mapping.ts#L382-L418
- https://github.com/jridgewell/babel/blob/518e1a6de4e05613ebf3aaf2c35e598e1dbcdb63/packages/babel-generator/src/source-map.ts#L82-L101
